summary: Master stakeholder communication and expectation management with practical tools, scorecards, and conflict-ready methods. Enroll to improve alignment and report
lede: Communication with stakeholders helps project managers, PMO staff, and change professionals align expectations across projects and change initiatives. The course covers influence mapping, audience-based communication planning, expectation setting, and conflict handling, with practice creating stakeholder registers and engagement scorecards. It also addresses feedback loops, escalation paths, and executive reporting so participants can track engagement and communicate risks clearly.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already manage stakeholders, meetings, updates, or change communications and need a stronger method for expectation control, alignment, and reporting.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop, basic office software, and a current or recent stakeholder challenge from your work. Familiarity with project terminology such as milestones, dependencies, risks, and escalation points will help you apply the exercises quickly.
